# [Implementation Plan] - Plan artifacts are wrong end to end

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #283 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

## 5. Manual Smoke Test Protocol

**Mandatory.** Run after `npm run build`, on a machine with the repo checked out.
It must be executed against a **scratch workspace outside `/tmp`** (the CLI
refuses mutations in unrecognised isolation directories; `/tmp` produces false
failures). Use a `gh` shim so the run is offline and deterministic.

Save the workspace under `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-283` and paste the final
`PASS/FAIL` summary into the execution log.

```bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO="$(pwd)"                       # run from the repo root, after npm run build
CLI=(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js")
BASE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-283-$(date +%s)"
mkdir -p "$BASE"; cd "$BASE"

git init -q .
git config user.email smoke@example.com
git config user.name  smoke
git checkout -q -b main
printf '# smoke\n' > README.md
git add README.md && git commit -qm 'init'

# Offline: any gh call fails fast and is ignored by the gateway.
mkdir -p shim
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 127\n' > shim/gh
chmod +x shim/gh
export PATH="$BASE/shim:$PATH"

pass=0; fail=0
ok()   { pass=$((pass+1)); printf 'PASS  %s\n' "$1"; }
no()   { fail=$((fail+1)); printf 'FAIL  %s\n' "$1"; }
check(){ if eval "$1"; then ok "$2"; else no "$2"; fi; }
dirs() { find artifacts/plans -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '; }
plan_dir() { find artifacts/plans -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1; }
# A named issue writes `.agyloop/tasks/<issue>.json`; the root file is for ad-hoc runs.
# `state()` prints the RAW value: JSON.stringify would quote strings, making
# `[ "$(state 283 s.currentStage)" = "PLAN" ]` fail spuriously (S4.4/S7.1).
state() { node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));const v=eval(process.argv[2]);console.log(typeof v==="string"?v:JSON.stringify(v))' ".agyloop/tasks/$1.json" "$2"; }

########## S1 — DISCOVERY scaffolds ONE canonical directory (AC-283.1, AC-299.1) ##########
"${CLI[@]}" transition DISCOVERY --issue 283 --title "[Bug] The base's own new commits" >/dev/null
check '[ "$(dirs)" -eq 1 ]' 'S1.1 exactly one plan directory'
DIR="$(plan_dir)"
REALDIR="$(cd "$DIR" && pwd)"
check '[ -n "$(find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "[[]Discovery[]]*.md" -print -quit)" ]' 'S1.2 discovery artifact exists'
check 'head -1 "$DIR/implementation_plan.md" | grep -q "^# \[Implementation\] - "' 'S1.3 mirror is the implementation template'
check '! grep -q "Root Cause Analysis" "$DIR/implementation_plan.md"' 'S1.4 mirror has no RCA heading'
check '! cmp -s "$DIR"/\[Discovery\]*.md "$DIR/implementation_plan.md"' 'S1.5 artifacts are not byte-identical (AC-299.6)'
check '[ "$(find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "[[]Discovery[]]*.md" | wc -l | tr -d " ")" -eq 1 ]' 'S1.6 exactly one discovery artifact'

########## S2 — populate the RCA report (AC-283.2) ##########
cat > "$DIR"/\[Discovery\]*.md <<'EOF'
# [Discovery] - The base's own new commits

**Issue:** #283
**Date:** 2026-10-26
**Author:** AgyLoop Discovery Subagent

## 1. Problem Statement & Symptoms
- **Observed Behavior:** plan scaffolds a second directory and parks falsely
- **Expected Behavior:** one directory per issue; the populated report releases the gate
- **Affected Components / Paths:** src/infrastructure/file-plan-generator.ts

## 2. Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
- **Investigation Steps:** ran transition DISCOVERY, then plan, on a clean workspace
- **Identified Failure Mode:** scaffold re-derives the slug and adopts its own empty dir
- **Relevant Code References:** scaffoldPlanDirectory, hasPopulatedDiscoveryReport

## 3. Reproduction Steps & Verification Protocol
- **Local Reproduction Command:** codeloop transition DISCOVERY --issue 283
- **Failing Test Target:** tests/generator.test.ts

## 4. Remediation Strategy
- **Recommended Fix Approach:** single slug grammar plus populated-first adoption
- **Potential Regressions / Side Effects:** directory selection is now deterministic
EOF

########## S3 — next at DISCOVERY names the path and the advancing command (AC-292.1/.3/.5) ##########
"${CLI[@]}" next --issue 283 --json > next-discovery-1.json
"${CLI[@]}" next --issue 283 --json > next-discovery-2.json
check 'grep -q "codeloop plan --issue 283" next-discovery-1.json' 'S3.1 DISCOVERY directive names codeloop plan'
check 'grep -q "populated RCA report" next-discovery-1.json' 'S3.2 DISCOVERY condition is stated'
check 'grep -qF "$REALDIR/[Discovery]" next-discovery-1.json' 'S3.3 prompt carries the exact artifact path'
check '[ "$(state 283 "s.discoveryDispatchCount")" -eq 2 ]' 'S3.4 re-dispatch is recorded'

########## S4 — plan adopts the existing directory and advances to PLAN (AC-283.1/.5) ##########
BEFORE="$(dirs)"
OUT="$("${CLI[@]}" plan --issue 283 --title "[Bug] The base's own new commits")"
check '[ "$(dirs)" -eq "$BEFORE" ]' 'S4.1 plan created NO second directory'
check 'echo "$OUT" | grep -q "Using existing plan directory"' 'S4.2 truthful resume message (AC-240.D5)'
check 'echo "$OUT" | grep -q "Specification (implementation): implementation_plan.md"' 'S4.3 spec labelled unambiguously (AC-299.3/.4)'
check '[ "$(state 283 "s.currentStage")" = "PLAN" ]' 'S4.4 advanced to PLAN without a manual copy'
check '[ "$(find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "[[]Discovery[]]*.md" | wc -l | tr -d " ")" -eq 1 ]' 'S4.5 plan did not add a second discovery artifact'
check 'grep -q "Observed Behavior" "$DIR"/\[Discovery\]*.md && grep -q "plan scaffolds a second directory" "$DIR"/\[Discovery\]*.md' 'S4.6 the populated report was preserved'

########## S5 — second plan run is truthful (AC-240.D5) ##########
OUT2="$("${CLI[@]}" plan --issue 283 --title "[Bug] The base's own new commits")"
check 'echo "$OUT2" | grep -q "Using existing plan directory"' 'S5.1 resumption is named'
check '! echo "$OUT2" | grep -q "Initialized plan directory"' 'S5.2 no false initialization'

########## S6 — next at PLAN names the advancing command (AC-292.2/.4) ##########
"${CLI[@]}" next --issue 283 --json > next-plan.json
check 'grep -q "codeloop transition APPROVAL --issue 283" next-plan.json' 'S6.1 PLAN directive names transition APPROVAL'
check 'grep -q "plan file is non-blank" next-plan.json' 'S6.2 PLAN condition is stated'
check 'grep -q "implementation_plan.md" next-plan.json' 'S6.3 target is the technical specification'

########## S7 — a pristine report still parks and names the checked path (AC-283.3) ##########
rm -rf artifacts/plans/999-* .agyloop/tasks/999.json
"${CLI[@]}" transition DISCOVERY --issue 999 --title "[Bug] pristine report probe" >/dev/null
OUT3="$("${CLI[@]}" plan --issue 999 --title "[Bug] pristine report probe")"
check '[ "$(state 999 "s.currentStage")" = "DISCOVERY" ]' 'S7.1 pristine scaffold still parks'
check 'echo "$OUT3" | grep -q "Checked:"' 'S7.2 park names the checked path(s)'

########## S8 — blank-plan YOLO park is recoverable through `next` (AC-267) ##########
"${CLI[@]}" yolo --issue 556 --title "feature probe" --type implementation > yolo.out 2> yolo.err || true
check 'grep -qi "blank scaffold" yolo.err' 'S8.1 YOLO parks on the blank plan'
check 'grep -q "codeloop next" yolo.err' 'S8.2 the park names an actionable next step'
"${CLI[@]}" yolo --issue 556 --title "feature probe" --type implementation > yolo2.out 2> yolo2.err || true
check 'grep -qi "attempt 2" yolo2.err' 'S8.3 the second park is not identical (AC-267.A5)'
"${CLI[@]}" next --issue 556 --json > next-blank.json
# An ABSOLUTE path: a bare relative name is resolved as a package by `require`
# (MODULE_NOT_FOUND). `$PWD` is the scratch workspace created above.
check 'node -e "const j=require(process.argv[1]); process.exit(j.role===\"planner\"?0:1)" "$PWD/next-blank.json"' 'S8.4 next offers the PLANNER'
PLAN556="$(find artifacts/plans/556-* -maxdepth 1 -name implementation_plan.md | head -1)"
cat > "$PLAN556" <<'EOF'
# [Implementation] - feature probe

## 3. Implementation Steps
- [ ] **Step 1:** Edit `src/probe.ts` so the probe returns a value.
EOF
"${CLI[@]}" next --issue 556 --json > next-filled.json
check 'node -e "const j=require(process.argv[1]); process.exit(j.role===\"implementer\"?0:1)" "$PWD/next-filled.json"' 'S8.5 next offers the IMPLEMENTER once the plan is real'
check '! grep -q "codeloop plan --issue 556" next-filled.json' 'S8.6 the planner directive is gone once the plan is real'

########## S9 — supplied plan creates no competing directory (AC-267.B2/B3) ##########
mkdir -p "$BASE/supplied"
printf '# [Implementation] - supplied\n\n## 3. Implementation Steps\n- [ ] **Step 1:** noop\n' > "$BASE/supplied/plan.md"
: > "$BASE/supplied/blank.md"
BEFORE="$(dirs)"
"${CLI[@]}" plan --issue 283 --plan-path "$BASE/supplied/plan.md" > supplied.out
check '[ "$(dirs)" -eq "$BEFORE" ]' 'S9.1 supplied plan created no competing directory'
check 'grep -q "Using supplied plan" supplied.out' 'S9.2 the message reflects the supplied plan'
set +e
"${CLI[@]}" plan --issue 283 --plan-path "$BASE/supplied/blank.md" > blank.out 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
check '[ "$RC" -ne 0 ]' 'S9.3 a blank supplied plan is rejected'
check 'grep -qi "blank" blank.out' 'S9.4 the diagnostic says the plan is blank'

printf '\n%d passed, %d failed\n' "$pass" "$fail"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]
```

**Expected outcome:** `0 failed`. Any failure is a blocker; the protocol is
re-run from a clean `$BASE` after a fix. Paste the summary line and the
`S1.x`–`S9.x` labels into `CodeLoop Summary.md` under "Quality Gate Metrics".

> The smoke protocol intentionally stops at "implementer payload obtainable".
> Executing code is the dispatched implementer subagent's job, not the CLI's;
> the AC only requires that the named recovery path be executable end to end.
